name: Health
description: Waterborne disease, sanitation access, hygiene behaviour, healthcare systems, and physical and mental well-being shaped by water.

name: Infrastructure
description: Pipes, treatment plants, latrines, sanitation chains, water points, and the physical systems that move water and waste.

name: Governance
description: Policy, regulation, accountability, financing, data systems, and the institutions that manage water and sanitation services.

name: Culture
description: History, identity, tradition, spiritual relationships with water, and the social meanings that shape how water is used, protected, and understood.

name: Gender
description: Gendered labour in water collection and care work, safety, dignity, women's participation in WASH decisions, and unequal burden-sharing.

name: Climate
description: Rainfall variability, drought, flooding, ecosystem health, land use, and the environmental systems that shape water availability.

name: Livelihoods
description: Agriculture, income, economic survival, resource recovery, water-food linkages, and the ways water connects to how people earn and sustain life.

name: Knowledge / Collaboration
description: Research, data, education, community knowledge, Indigenous perspectives, knowledge mobilization, and the collaborative production of understanding.
